description: This file is a Perl script that functions as a replacement for brcmImagebuilder. It reads kernel and root filesystem images, processes command-line arguments for various configuration options, and generates a combined image with a specific header and formatting suitable for embedded systems like routers or similar hardware.

methods.name: Read_Image
methods.description: Reads entire contents of a specified file into a scalar variable.

methods.name: Padlen
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes needed to pad a length to a specified block size.

methods.name: Pad
methods.description: Pads a buffer with 0xFF bytes to align it to a block size with a certain offset.

methods.name: bcmImage
methods.description: Creates a combined firmware image by constructing a header and appending kernel and root filesystem images, with optional formatting based on input arguments.
